response: {"thought": "語意層已定義配送天數與期間歸屬規則，但訂單時間欄位 order_ts 的時區不明。我需要先用 Taipei(+8h) 與原始時間兩種口徑計算黑貓 2025 年的平均，並檢查 order_ts 與出貨時間的先後關係來判斷時區基準。", "tool": "sql_query", "queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)),2) avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.carrier='blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025'", "SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)),2) avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.carrier='blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', o.order_ts)='2025'", "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts > s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_after_ship, SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') > s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) taipei_after_ship, COUNT(*) n FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.carrier='blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"]}
